rust_test_command: cargo test -p rustycad-tkernel --test flat_legacy_cursor --test ncollection_flat_data_map --test ncollection_flat_maps_api_behavior
behaviors: Non-consuming mutable access updates the underlying binding and is visible through a shared read view.
Mutable cursor advances through the same slot order as the immutable native cursor.
Distinct live cursors compare unequal; all exhausted cursors, including past-end advancement, compare equal.
Default and exhausted access returns exact native Standard_OutOfRange messages for Key, Value and ChangeValue.
remaining_limits: Mutating through a const map or concurrently retained mutable cursor aliases is not represented by the exclusive Rust cursor. Native mutable iterator construction and ChangeValue remain partial for these defined aliasing cases.
Read-only cursor views borrow the mutable owner and cannot outlive or overlap its mutation.
